title: Arctic Daylight
summary: A crisp cool-light theme with blue-gray structure, clean white surfaces, and teal focus accents.
details: Arctic Daylight is built for bright rooms and high-density review. Cool gray-blue separators make complex panes easy to parse, while the white working surface stays clean without losing the distinction between controls, drawers, and evidence regions.
features: Crisp daylight surfaces for bright working environments
Blue-gray structural layers for complex pane layouts
Teal focus cues with accessible light-background status colors
